SOURCE_MANIFEST.json records immutable commits, URLs and SHA-256 values. The 1.0.2 function and PR #23214 merged function are executed without body edits, extracted as AST function definitions; modern scikit-learn supplies a compatibility counting backend whose output is checked against direct membership masks. The 1.1.0 snapshot was inspected during provenance checks and is not used as the fixed implementation: that tag still contains the truncation path. This experiment does not claim installation or execution of the historical scikit-learn distribution binary.

The upstream issue and merge demonstrate one confirmed defect. Thirty-one inputs and repeated checks of that defect do not represent thirty-one independently discovered bugs. No upstream message, issue or PR was sent as part of this study.
